app.brand.description: Name at the top left of every screen, beside the logo. “Tabsend” is the product name: keep it. “Console” is what this web page is called; the first screen explains it.

app.loading.description: Shown in the middle of the page while the saved pairing is read, before anything else appears.

app.header.thisConsole.description: Tooltip on this console's own name at the top right. The name beside it is what this browser is called in the group.

app.header.back.description: Link at the top right before this console is paired. It goes to the Tabsend website. “tabsend.org” is an address: keep it.

app.tab.devices.description: Tab label for the list of devices in the group. Short, one word if possible.

app.tab.history.description: Tab label for the list of tabs sent between devices. Short, one word if possible.

app.tab.account.description: Tab label for details about this console's pairing and what to do after losing every device. Short, one word if possible.

app.footer.label.description: Spoken name of the row of links at the bottom of every screen; a screen reader says it before the links. Not shown on the page.

app.footer.site.description: Footer link to the Tabsend website. It is an address: keep it as it is.

app.footer.privacy.description: Footer link to the privacy policy. Only shown when this console is served by Tabsend's own hosted service.

app.footer.terms.description: Footer link to the terms of service. Only shown when this console is served by Tabsend's own hosted service.

app.footer.support.description: Footer link to the support page on the Tabsend website.
